Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S11 Existing spec: Regenerate requests a fresh suggestion for the new note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient with a generated note and its billing

When The note is regenerated (new noteGeneratedAt and text)

Then A second billing request carries the new note; the saved billing belongs to the new note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in billing-suggestion.spec.ts: two suggestBilling calls, the second with the regenerated note; billingForNoteAt = the second generatedAt. Whether Regenerate should re-bill at all is Q4. Pass shows only that a newer note gets a newer suggestion (main's browser-side re-fetch when noteGeneratedAt changes, driven by a direct rounding:update while Post-Round i …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
